blind_spot: I verified every chart through the DOM that Recharts produced, and Recharts is exactly where this tab's two worst defects hid — a ReferenceLine silently discarded for ending 30 units outside an auto domain, and a series flattened to 2.2 px. Both are invisible to the unit suite because ExecutiveTab.test.jsx mocks recharts wholesale (lines 24-63: every component becomes a <div data-props=JSON>), so the מ6 test at line 646 asserts `segment === [{x:0,y:0},{x:520,y:520}]` against a stub and is green while the live line does not exist. The concrete, checkable consequence: EVERY claim this tab makes about chart geometry — axis domains, is_today shading, the shape channel, ref-line placement, the composed bar+line split — is a claim about props, not about pixels, and nothing in the repo re-checks any of them in a browser. The one thing worth adding after this round is a Playwright assertion per chart of the form 'the element the card says is on this chart exists in the SVG' (count of .recharts-reference-line-line, count of stroke-dasharray bars, curve bounding-box height > N px) — and it should be pointed at מ9's aging chart and מ17's Lorenz diagonal too, because both are the same ReferenceLine-with-segment construct as מ6's and I did not open either.
